newsitem.title: USA: Corning spin off proposal cleared by IRS.
newsitem.headline: Corning spin off proposal cleared by IRS.

text.p: Corning Inc said Friday it had received approval from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service for a tax-free spin-off of its health care services segment.
Corning plans to distribute to its shareholders stock in two new independent companies -- Corning Clinical Laboratories Inc and Covance Inc, which was formerly Corning Pharmaceutical Services Inc.
As previously reported, the company believes it is on track for a year-end completion of the transaction.
Corning Clinical Labs is one of the largest clinical laboratory testing companies in the U.S. Revenues in 1995 totaled $1.6 billion.
Covance, based in Princeton, N.J., is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical development service companies. Its 1995 revenues were more than $400 million.
